description.value: Bella Gelateria is an internationally acclaimed artisan gelato shop on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, holding a Gelato Festival World Ranking No. 1 and winning the Georgia Straight's Best Gelato/Ice Cream award nearly every year since 2010. All gelato is made in small batches from scratch using 100% natural ingredients and Italian Effi machines — the first of their kind in Vancouver. The shop offers gelato, sorbetto, chocolate gelato, pastries, and drinks, with options for vegan, dairy-free, gluten-free, and nut-free diets.
